summary: A small pop-up tip that points at part of the browser to highlight or explain a feature.
description: FeatureCallout is a plain ES class (not a custom element) that renders ASRouter/onboarding tour messages as a popup anchored to a CSS-selected element — a XUL <panel> in the browser chrome (when a panel_position is configured), or an absolutely/relatively positioned <div> in content pages such as Firefox View. Manages multi-screen tour progress via a pref, screen advancement, and focus/positioning lifecycle.

attributes.name: win
attributes.description: Constructor option; the window the callout will render into.

attributes.name: pref
attributes.description: Constructor option; optional pref used to track progress through a multi-screen tour, e.g. { name: "browser.pdfjs.feature-tour" }.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Constructor option; string passed as the page when requesting messages from ASRouter and sending telemetry.

attributes.name: context
attributes.description: Constructor option; "chrome" when shown in the browser chrome, "content" when shown in a content page (e.g. Firefox View).

attributes.name: browser
attributes.description: Constructor option; the <browser> element the callout is being shown in/for. Defaults to win.docShell.chromeEventHandler.

attributes.name: listener
attributes.description: Constructor option; callback invoked on various callout lifecycle events to keep an external broker informed of state.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Constructor option; see FeatureCallout's themePresets for accepted shapes.

methods.name: showFeatureCallout
methods.description: async showFeatureCallout(message?): requests (or accepts) a message from ASRouter and renders the callout for it; returns a Promise<boolean> for whether a message ended up shown.

methods.name: endTour
methods.description: endTour(skipFadeOut = false): tears down the current callout and its listeners, notifying the listener callback with 'end'.

methods.name: setupFeatureTourProgress
methods.description: Starts observing the configured pref (if any) to track/advance tour progress.

methods.name: teardownFeatureTourProgress
methods.description: Stops observing the pref and clears cached progress.

methods.name: featureTourProgress
methods.description: Getter returning the parsed current progress value read from the pref.

methods.name: onViewOpen
methods.description: Called by the urlbar controller listener; ends the tour when the urlbar view opens, to avoid overlapping popups.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Central DOM event handler for focus, keypress (Escape), visibilitychange, resize, popupshowing/popuphiding, and unload.

methods.name: getAutoFocusElement
methods.description: getAutoFocusElement({ selector, use_defaults }): resolves which element inside the callout should receive focus when it renders.
